function.name: send_whatsapp
function.description: Send the customer a WhatsApp message during the call with ElevateBox pricing, portfolio or details. Use it when the customer asks for details, pricing, examples or a WhatsApp, or shows clear buying intent. Call it at most once per call.

note.description: One short, friendly sentence to the customer that refers to what they told you, e.g. 'Great to hear your saree business is going online.' No links.

messages.content: Sure, sending that to your WhatsApp now.
